task: 4. Create mandatory reproducible signed model-source artifacts for every public build
method: copy archive + .sha256 sidecar; flip one byte at three offsets; build-model-archive.sh --verify must exit non-zero. Clean archive + sidecar must verify (exit 0).
verification_layers: whole-archive sha256 vs .sha256 sidecar (catches any byte flip in the gzip container)
per-file sha256 vs MANIFEST.json (catches content tamper even without sidecar)
per-model sha256 vs packaging/model-manifest.toml (catches model substitution)
